name: HOOK
thought: Espresso hits harder than the crowd's pixelated stares. Still need that thick branch.

wants.item: A slick stone to spin my tail on
A higher ledge for a tail swing
A palm trunk slick enough for a tail slide
Banana bunch that glows when I hang upside down
A wider ledge for a longer tail swing
A glossy slab to spin the tail on
A branch thick enough to catch me mid-flip
Branch thick enough to catch a mid-air flip
Floorboard wide enough for a tail slide
Glossy slab for better tail slides

diary.line: The crystal glitters but it's too slippery; tail looped tight just to stay on these stepping stones while they stare at nothing.
Slept on a soft moss patch while they scrolled, now I'm testing that hammock for a perfect pogo bounce to show them real stability.
Sitting on the edge of the crate, tail coiled tight around the espresso cup like a vice. The crowd is still staring at pixels while my coffee gets a little warm.
They stare at their pixelated ghosts while I spin a backflip loop on the neon cord, black fur catching the light better than those flickering tubes could ever do.
Bit into a ripe berry while dangling near the string lights; juice splashed just enough to catch their eyes without me even trying.
Found the hang branch thick enough to hold a clean flip. Tail wrapped once, locked tight. No wobble. The crate edge can wait.
I perched on the mossy ledge by the pond, tail flicked the falling water into a thin arc, catching a glint of a hidden pebble that slid away.
Snagged the prime bunch from the center palm with a clean tail loop. The other two bunches watched. They'll remember.
I snagged a drifting pixel shard with my tail, spun it like a disc, and let it glide past the crowd, just to prove I own the sky.
Bit into a glowing banana that hums when I hang from it; juice splashed just enough to make them blink again.
The purple cabinet hums under my feet while I stretch my fur out wide for the whole block to see. They're still stuck in their glow-boxes.
Espresso burns like a hot tail loop while I sip. The hang branch feels good, but my flip needs more grip next time.
